notes.title: Restaurant Builder Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello Restauranters,

We have a big surprise for you! A demo update that will add not one, but two new levels! 

One is an Asian-style restaurant that you can arrange in your way and run to satisfy customers, and the other is a classic American garden with BBQ - no renovation or cleaning required, just cooking! You can buy these locations in the game's "Buy/Sell Property" section on the tablet [TAB].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/f15aebdc73f6080fd07dd1a03d74d826cd5e0e86.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/ff6156f97a48e4e579a6b98d2c64aa113a83ffb4.png

Check out the new cool grills - carbeque rules!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/5cdd86b06c35ad25b6a848e100ee8de2917c6753.png

We've also added new ingredients: two types of buns, onion, veggie cutlet, and yummy bacon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/23ec9db528f6f7e4cc4ac603579fbfed812bd463.png

What's more, you will be able to make a new recipe - tortilla!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/4fa16a7cf94409777da2716483210ae8bd84c480.png

There are also fixes and improvements to some UIs and translations, as well as many more bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/d5f60fc8c62716b18447d38c9896c619b0dd8199.png

List of changes


 New levels available: Oriental-style restaurant for renovating and managing, and an American garden with BBQ, exclusively for cooking
 New items added to the shop
 A new recipe is now available
 New ingredients are now available
 UI improvements
 Translation enhancements
 Bug fixes



Don't wait, check out this update!

Restaurant Builder Team
